output.summary: Spiny evergreen shrub native to tropical and southern Africa. It has glossy leaves, fragrant white flowers whose scent strengthens at night, and crimson fruit that may appear year-round in moderate coastal areas. The fruit is eaten raw or made into pies, preserves and sauces.
output.edibilityNote: The fruit is eaten raw and made into pies, jams, jellies and sauces; it is also described as a traditional African food.
